+title: 'Model: SessionModel stream attachment, replay, missed updates, and close'
+---
+## What
+Add the stream life of `SessionModel` in `Sources/FoundationModelsACPClient/Model/SessionModel+Stream.swift`. All of it is internal; only `ConnectionModel` (later task) calls it. The UI never calls `updates(for:)`.
+
+- [ ] `attach(to stream: AsyncStream<SessionUpdate>, overflowed: Bool)`: starts one `@MainActor` task that calls `apply` for each update in order. `overflowed == true` sets public `hasMissedUpdates = true`.
+- [ ] Replay: `beginReplay()` sets `isReplaying = true` before the `session/resume` request; `endReplay(response:)` sets `isReplaying = false` and `history = .retained(replayFrom:)` from the response. A failed resume ends the replay too. Public `history: SessionHistory` (`.live`, `.retained(replayFrom:)` — take the exact case shape from the alpha.7 resume response).
+- [ ] `markClosed()`: flushes coalesced chunks, cancels the stream task, cancels every pending permission and elicitation of the session (when that task is done; leave a hook), sets `isClosed = true`. After close, `apply` changes nothing.
+- [ ] This replaces `beginRehydration` / `endRehydration` / `cancelRehydration` of `ACPSessionState`: alpha.7 replay means retained history, folded as it arrives.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] Updates on the attached stream land in order in the model.
+- [ ] `isReplaying` is true between `beginReplay()` and `endReplay`, and false after a failure.
+- [ ] After `markClosed()`, `isClosed == true` and new updates change nothing.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] New `Tests/FoundationModelsACPClientTests/Model/SessionModelStreamTests.swift`: attach a hand-made `AsyncStream`, yield updates, assert transcript; overflow flag sets `hasMissedUpdates`; replay flags; close stops the fold and cancels the stream task.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter SessionModelStreamTests` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
